verdict.rationale: Apify publishes an OpenAPI spec and official JS and Python API clients. The docs show these clients running Actors, persisting and running tasks, streaming logs, registering webhooks and exporting datasets, so a broad set of core platform actions is programmatic. However, no evidence states that the API matches the UI feature for feature, and several UI areas are not shown as API-accessible. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that schedules, organization/permission management, monitoring/alerts and Store publishing are exposed via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
